design: Measure squared raw MLP response error/effect, squared final-normalized residual error/effect, and cached native KL error/effect. Compare pooled relative errors and log stage ratios, plus raw per-site error normalized by intact final-state squared norm common to all conditions. Audit cached KL on first4 sites of every condition/amplitude.

gates.cached_kl_replay: max prediction and baseline KL error on audit sites <1e-10
gates.raw_unit99: all18 raw unit relative-error simultaneous upper bounds <.01
gates.normalization_suppresses: all36 log(normalized relative error / raw relative error) joint72 upper bounds <0
gates.readout_suppresses: all36 log(KL relative error / normalized relative error) joint72 upper bounds <0
